title: Agent foundations with the Claude Agent SDK
description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on what an AI agent is and how to run one with the Claude Agent SDK for Python: the agent loop, tools and their results, what a run costs, instructions, models, permissions, conversations, sessions, streaming and structured output.

workshops.name: your-first-agent
workshops.title: Run your first agent
workshops.description: Find out what an AI agent is by running one with the Claude Agent SDK. Send a prompt and take apart the messages that come back, ask a question the model cannot answer on its own, then give it one tool and watch it read a file to get the answer.
